cues.en: In this video, I'm going to introduce you to a few different but related methods for analyzing clustering in high dimensional data.
cues.zh: 這部影片會介紹幾種不同、但彼此相關的方法，用來分析高維資料中的分群。

cues.en: One method is called t-SNE and the other is called DBscan.
cues.zh: 一種叫 t-SNE，另一種叫 DBSCAN。

cues.en: t-SNE is for projecting high dimensional data down to a lower dimensional space.
cues.zh: t-SNE 用來把高維資料投影到較低維的空間。

cues.en: For example, for visualization or denoising or clustering, and DBscan can be used for identifying
cues.zh: 例如用於視覺化、去雜訊或分群；DBSCAN 則可以根據局部距離，辨識

cues.en: groups of data values based on local distances.
cues.zh: 資料值所形成的群組。

cues.en: And I will also introduce you to something called a gram matrix, which you've actually already seen before.
cues.zh: 我也會介紹所謂的 Gram 矩陣，其實你已經看過。

cues.en: You're already familiar with gram matrices, even if you don't recognize the name.
cues.zh: 即使不認得名稱，你已經很熟悉 Gram 矩陣。

cues.en: Okay, so there's a lot to cover, but you will see these methods appear repeatedly throughout the course, so you will become quite familiar with them.
cues.zh: 要談的內容很多，但這些方法會在整門課反覆出現，所以你會相當熟悉。

cues.en: Let's start with t-SNE.
cues.zh: 先從 t-SNE 開始。

cues.en: Here's the paper that describes this method.
cues.zh: 這是介紹該方法的論文。

cues.en: The senior author, by the way, is Geoff Hinton, who is one of the most important figures in AI and deep learning.
cues.zh: 順帶一提，資深作者是 Geoff Hinton，他是 AI 與深度學習領域最重要的人物之一。

cues.en: So the general goal of this method is to reduce the dimensionality of high dimensional data down to
cues.zh: 這個方法的整體目標，是將高維資料的維度降到

cues.en: a dimensionality that is easier to work with and also ideally visualizable.
cues.zh: 比較容易處理，而且理想上可以視覺化的維度。

cues.en: So two dimensions or sometimes three dimensions.
cues.zh: 也就是二維，有時是三維。

cues.en: So here's the idea.
cues.zh: 概念如下。

cues.en: We consider that the probability of two points in a high dimensional space being considered neighbors is proportional to their Euclidean distance.
cues.zh: 我們認為，高維空間中的兩個點被視為鄰居的機率，與它們的歐幾里得距離成比例。

cues.en: This means that if two points are close to each other, they're more likely to be neighbors.
cues.zh: 意思是，兩點越接近，就越可能是鄰居。

cues.en: And if two points are further away from each other, they are less likely to be neighbors.
cues.zh: 兩點越遠，就越不可能是鄰居。

cues.en: Very intuitive.
cues.zh: 非常直覺。

cues.en: Then the next step is to find a lower dimensional map where the probability distribution across all
cues.zh: 接著，找出一個低維映射，讓所有點之間的機率分布，

cues.en: the points is the same as in the higher dimension.
cues.zh: 與高維空間中相同。

cues.en: Now, this means that we want to find a low dimensional representation of the data where the distances
cues.zh: 也就是想找出資料的一種低維表示，其中距離

cues.en: themselves might be different, but the probability distribution of those distances is as close as possible
cues.zh: 本身可能不同，但這些距離的機率分布，盡可能接近

cues.en: to the distribution of distances in the higher dimensional space.
cues.zh: 高維空間中的距離分布。

cues.en: Okay, so the basic math of t-SNE is not so difficult.
cues.zh: t-SNE 的基本數學其實不太難。

cues.en: And it actually uses a lot of the math that you've already learned in this course and maybe in other courses on deep learning or machine learning.
cues.zh: 而且會用到很多你在本課程，或其他深度學習、機器學習課程中，已經學過的數學。

cues.en: So let's start with this equation up here.
cues.zh: 先看上面這個方程式。

cues.en: So this is the probabilities of points I and J being neighbors.
cues.zh: 這是點 i 與點 j 互為鄰居的機率。

cues.en: Notice that the numerator is an exponential term, and the denominator is the sum of exponential terms.
cues.zh: 注意，分子是指數項，分母是指數項的總和。

cues.en: And that means that this is literally just a softmax function which you are quite familiar with.
cues.zh: 因此，這其實就是你很熟悉的 softmax 函式。

cues.en: And what is inside that softmax?
cues.zh: softmax 裡面是什麼？

cues.en: Well it's the distance between two points.
cues.zh: 是兩個點之間的距離。

cues.en: So the magnitude squared of the difference vector.
cues.zh: 也就是差向量大小的平方。

cues.en: That's just the Euclidean distance.
cues.zh: 這就是歐幾里得距離。

cues.en: So essentially we are calculating all the Euclidean distances between embeddings vectors pushing them
cues.zh: 基本上，我們計算所有嵌入向量之間的歐幾里得距離，

cues.en: through a softmax function to get probabilities and then storing the distribution of all of those probabilities.
cues.zh: 透過 softmax 函式轉成機率，再儲存所有這些機率的分布。

cues.en: This comes from the observed data here x.
cues.zh: 這來自這裡的觀測資料 x。

cues.en: Then we have this equation here, which is almost exactly the same, except now we have y instead of x.
cues.zh: 接著是這個方程式，幾乎完全相同，只是把 x 換成 y。

cues.en: So the idea is that y is a lower dimensional map, and q is the distribution of all of those probabilities.
cues.zh: y 是一個低維映射，q 則是所有這些機率的分布。

cues.en: So now we have two probability distributions.
cues.zh: 現在有兩個機率分布。

cues.en: And we want to get them to match.
cues.zh: 我們想讓它們相符。

cues.en: And that is done by defining a cost function to be the KL divergence between these two probability distributions.
cues.zh: 做法是把這兩個機率分布之間的 KL 散度，定義成成本函數。

cues.en: I hope that makes sense.
cues.zh: 希望這樣說清楚了。

cues.en: So essentially we are trying to find a low dimensional representation of the data such that the softmax
cues.zh: 基本上，我們想找資料的一種低維表示，讓距離經 softmax 轉換後的

cues.en: probability distributions of distances are preserved from the high dimensional distribution.
cues.zh: 機率分布，能保留高維分布中的情況。

cues.en: Now actually finding these values of Y is comes from an iterative algorithm that is based on gradient
cues.zh: 實際找出這些 y 值，則來自以梯度下降為基礎的迭代演算法，

cues.en: descent, where the KL divergence is the cost or the loss function that the model tries to minimize.
cues.zh: 其中 KL 散度就是模型要最小化的成本或損失函數。

cues.en: So there's quite a few more details in how this method actually gets implemented.
cues.zh: 這個方法真正實作時，還有不少細節。

cues.en: I'm not going to get into all of that here.
cues.zh: 這裡不會全部深入討論。

cues.en: It's described in detail in this paper.
cues.zh: 這篇論文有詳細描述。

cues.en: But what I would like to point out is that this method is based on probability distributions from softmax function and on gradient descent.
cues.zh: 但我想指出，這個方法是以 softmax 函式的機率分布，以及梯度下降為基礎。

cues.en: And that means that the results of this method are probabilistic.
cues.zh: 這表示方法的結果具有機率性。

cues.en: They are not deterministic.
cues.zh: 並不是確定性的。

cues.en: So if you run this algorithm on the same data multiple times, you're going to get multiple different results.
cues.zh: 所以，如果對相同資料多次執行演算法，就會得到多個不同的結果。

cues.en: Now hopefully if there really is true clustering or organization in the data, the results should be pretty similar.
cues.zh: 如果資料真的有分群或組織結構，希望每次重新執行，

cues.en: Each time you rerun it, but you're not guaranteed to get exactly the same results.
cues.zh: 結果都會相當類似，但不能保證完全相同。

cues.en: You can also see that there are some parameters to this algorithm.
cues.zh: 你也可以看到，這個演算法有一些參數。

cues.en: I'm not going to talk about that here in this video.
cues.zh: 這部影片不會討論。

cues.en: I will get back to the issue of parameter selection later on in the course.
cues.zh: 課程之後會再談參數選擇的問題。

cues.en: So I want to show you one example of this method.
cues.zh: 先展示這個方法的一個例子。

cues.en: What you're looking at here is called the mNIST dataset of handwritten digits.
cues.zh: 這是稱為 MNIST 的手寫數字資料集。

cues.en: It's a famous data set in machine learning and computer vision, so you might have come across it before.
cues.zh: 它是機器學習與電腦視覺領域著名的資料集，你可能已經接觸過。

cues.en: So what the authors of the paper did was take all of the pixel values across 6000 different examples
cues.zh: 論文作者把 6,000 個不同手寫數字範例的所有像素值，

cues.en: of handwritten digits, run it through their t-SNE algorithm, and then they found that the clustering,
cues.zh: 送入 t-SNE 演算法，接著發現這些群組，

cues.en: when projected down to two dimensions, very clearly grouped all of the different digits together.
cues.zh: 投影到二維後，非常清楚地將各種不同數字分開聚在一起。

cues.en: So each of these colors here corresponds to a different digit, a different number.
cues.zh: 這裡每一種顏色，都對應一個不同的數字。

cues.en: You can count them.
cues.zh: 你可以數一數。

cues.en: There's going to be ten of these here corresponding to the digits zero through nine.
cues.zh: 這裡會有十個，對應數字零到九。

cues.en: Okay so that's about t-SNE.
cues.zh: 以上是 t-SNE。

cues.en: This method just reduces the dimensionality.
cues.zh: 這個方法只是降維。

cues.en: It doesn't actually identify clusters in the data.
cues.zh: 並不會真正辨識資料中的群組。

cues.en: And that brings us to DBscan.
cues.zh: 這就帶到 DBSCAN。

cues.en: DBscan stands for density based spatial clustering of applications with noise.
cues.zh: DBSCAN 代表 density based spatial clustering of applications with noise。

cues.en: It's quite a mouthful.
cues.zh: 名稱相當拗口。

cues.en: You can see why they shortened it to DBscan.
cues.zh: 難怪要縮寫成 DBSCAN。

cues.en: Anyway, here you see an example that illustrates what the method can do.
cues.zh: 總之，這裡的例子顯示這個方法可以做什麼。

cues.en: So these are data points in a two dimensional space maybe I don't know.
cues.zh: 這些是二維空間中的資料點，不知道該怎麼形容。

cues.en: They look like trees in a landscape.
cues.zh: 看起來像景觀裡的樹。

cues.en: This is like a garden maze or something.
cues.zh: 像花園迷宮之類的。

cues.en: And you can see that there clearly are clusters.
cues.zh: 可以看到，顯然有群組。

cues.en: There's clearly structure here.
cues.zh: 這裡顯然有結構。

cues.en: And there's also these extreme points or outlier points that don't really belong to any of these clusters over here.
cues.zh: 另外，也有一些極端點或離群點，不真正屬於這裡任何群組。

cues.en: You see the result of applying DBscan to these data points.
cues.zh: 這是對資料點套用 DBSCAN 的結果。

cues.en: So DBscan was able to identify this structure based on local distances and clustering.
cues.zh: DBSCAN 能根據局部距離與分群，辨識這個結構。

cues.en: And it labeled these points around here as well DBscan calls them noise.
cues.zh: 至於這周圍的點，DBSCAN 將它們標記為雜訊。

cues.en: I don't really like that term because these are not They're not necessarily noise just because they don't fit into any other cluster.
cues.zh: 我不太喜歡這個名稱，因為它們不屬於其他群組，並不表示一定是雜訊。

cues.en: But anyway, that's literally right in the name.
cues.zh: 但這個詞就是直接寫在方法名稱裡。

cues.en: So that's how it is.
cues.zh: 所以只能這樣。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: So how does this method work?
cues.zh: 這個方法如何運作？

cues.en: It's actually quite simple.
cues.zh: 其實很簡單。

cues.en: There are some subtleties that can get a little complicated, but the basic algorithm of DBscan is pretty straightforward.
cues.zh: 有些細節可能有點複雜，但 DBSCAN 的基本演算法相當直接。

cues.en: So imagine all of these data points here.
cues.zh: 想像這裡所有資料點。

cues.en: Let's start by picking this point point n.
cues.zh: 先選這個點，點 n。

cues.en: So we have a parameter for the analysis called epsilon.
cues.zh: 分析有一個叫 epsilon 的參數。

cues.en: Greek letter epsilon that defines the minimum distance to create a cluster.
cues.zh: 希臘字母 epsilon，定義形成群組的最小距離。

cues.en: And that is depicted with this circle around each of these points.
cues.zh: 這裡用各個點周圍的圓表示。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: Then we ask are there any other data points within this particular distance threshold here.
cues.zh: 接著問，在這個特定距離門檻內，有沒有其他資料點？

cues.en: Now for this point N the answer is no.
cues.zh: 對點 n 而言，答案是沒有。

cues.en: So that's why we consider this to be noise.
cues.zh: 所以把它視為雜訊。

cues.en: Or at least it doesn't belong to any other cluster.
cues.zh: 或者至少，它不屬於任何其他群組。

cues.en: So now let's pick point B.
cues.zh: 現在選點 B。

cues.en: Now we see that there is a point within the distance threshold of B.
cues.zh: 可以看到，B 的距離門檻內有一個點。

cues.en: That's this one.
cues.zh: 就是這個。

cues.en: So we would consider these two points to be in a cluster.
cues.zh: 因此，會把這兩個點視為一個群組。

cues.en: And then we keep going from here.
cues.zh: 接著從這裡繼續。

cues.en: So each of these points has other points in the same cluster within their distance radius threshold.
cues.zh: 每個點在其距離半徑門檻內，都有同一群組中的其他點。

cues.en: So they all get grouped into a cluster.
cues.zh: 因此，將它們全部歸入一個群組。

cues.en: And we keep expanding our cluster until we have found all the points that are within the distance threshold of all the individual points in that cluster.
cues.zh: 持續擴展，直到找到該群組中各個點的距離門檻內，所有的點。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: So now we have inside this cluster our eight points.
cues.zh: 現在，這個群組裡有八個點。

cues.en: Now there's another parameter of the DBscan algorithm, which is the minimum number of points to consider a cluster to be a valid cluster.
cues.zh: DBSCAN 演算法還有另一個參數，也就是一個群組要被視為有效群組，所需的最少點數。

cues.en: So let's say our minimum number of points is four.
cues.zh: 假設最少點數是四個。

cues.en: So this cluster here is more than four points.
cues.zh: 這裡的群組超過四個點。

cues.en: So we keep this cluster On the other hand, let's say that we set our minimum number of points parameter to be ten.
cues.zh: 因此，保留這個群組。另一方面，假設把最少點數參數設成十個。

cues.en: Well, in that case, we do not consider this to be a cluster.
cues.zh: 那樣就不會把它視為一個群組。

cues.en: There aren't enough points in here because our parameter value was set to ten.
cues.zh: 這裡的點不夠，因為參數值設成十。

cues.en: So these all become non-clustered noise.
cues.zh: 所以這些全都變成未分群的雜訊。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: So that's it.
cues.zh: 就是這樣。

cues.en: That's the basic idea of DBscan.
cues.zh: 這就是 DBSCAN 的基本概念。

cues.en: As I mentioned, there are additional subtleties we can distinguish between what's called core points here versus reachable points in yellow.
cues.zh: 就像提到的，還有額外細節，例如區分這裡所謂的核心點，以及黃色的可達點。

cues.en: But I think you get the idea.
cues.zh: 但我想你已經了解概念。

cues.en: I'm not going to go into those nuances.
cues.zh: 這裡不會深入這些細微差異。

cues.en: I do want to say a few words about the two key parameters for this method.
cues.zh: 不過，想談談這個方法的兩個關鍵參數。

cues.en: The first is epsilon which is the distance threshold.
cues.zh: 第一個是 epsilon，也就是距離門檻。

cues.en: If epsilon is too small, then what should be one cluster gets broken up into multiple clusters.
cues.zh: 如果 epsilon 太小，原本應該是一群的資料，會被拆成多個群組。

cues.en: But if epsilon is too large, then you can get unique clusters that are spuriously merged into one.
cues.zh: 但 epsilon 太大，不同的群組又可能被錯誤合併。

cues.en: I'll show you an example of what that looks like on the next slide, and you will see this for yourself in a code challenge a little bit later on in this section.
cues.zh: 下一張投影片會展示例子，本節稍後的程式挑戰中，你也會親自看到。

cues.en: The other parameter is the minimum number of points to be considered a cluster.
cues.zh: 另一個參數，是被視為群組所需的最少點數。

cues.en: To be honest, you usually don't want to play around with this parameter too much.
cues.zh: 老實說，通常不會希望對這個參數做太多調整。

cues.en: Usually a value like 3 or 5 is a good minimum for this parameter.
cues.zh: 通常像 3 或 5，會是不錯的最小值。

cues.en: And again, you will explore this in a code challenge a little bit later on.
cues.zh: 稍後的程式挑戰，也會讓你探索。

cues.en: So here you see an example of clustering with DBscan.
cues.zh: 這裡是使用 DBSCAN 分群的例子。

cues.en: So here we got three clusters.
cues.zh: 得到三個群組。

cues.en: The green circles here correspond to the cluster means.
cues.zh: 這裡的綠色圓圈，對應群組平均值。

cues.en: So the center of gravity of these clusters.
cues.zh: 也就是群組的重心。

cues.en: And each data point is drawn with a line to the mean of that cluster that it was assigned to.
cues.zh: 每個資料點都有一條線，連到它被分配群組的平均值。

cues.en: Here I set the epsilon parameter to be too small.
cues.zh: 這裡把 epsilon 參數設得太小。

cues.en: So even though all of these points are clearly belonging to a cluster, they are technically considered
cues.zh: 即使所有點顯然屬於某個群組，但在技術上被認為

cues.en: too far away from each other, so they're all end up as being labeled non clusterable noise.
cues.zh: 彼此距離太遠，所以最後全部被標記成無法分群的雜訊。

cues.en: On the other hand, here I set the epsilon parameter to high and these two distinct clusters ended up merging into one.
cues.zh: 另一方面，這裡把 epsilon 設得太高，這兩個不同的群組就合併成一個。

cues.en: Now when you have really nicely cluster results like this, it's pretty obvious that there are three
cues.zh: 當分群結果像這樣漂亮時，顯然有三個

cues.en: clusters and you can adjust the epsilon parameter based on visual inspection and intuition.
cues.zh: 群組，可以根據目視檢查與直覺調整 epsilon 參數。

cues.en: But this is kind of hand-wavy.
cues.zh: 但這有點不夠嚴謹。

cues.en: It's kind of post-hoc.
cues.zh: 有點像事後決定。

cues.en: You will see that in real data.
cues.zh: 處理真實資料時，你會看到，

cues.en: It's sometimes the case that clusters really stand out, but many other times the clusters are just
cues.zh: 有時群組真的很突出，但很多時候，群組

cues.en: not so well differentiated and it's not so clear how to set the epsilon parameter.
cues.zh: 並沒有那麼明確分開，epsilon 參數該如何設定也不清楚。

cues.en: More generally, clustering is tricky business and it is a major and unsolved problem in machine learning.
cues.zh: 更一般地說，分群是棘手的事，也是機器學習中一個重大且尚未解決的問題。

cues.en: Later in this section, I will also introduce you to K-means and KNN, which are two other clustering methods.
cues.zh: 本節稍後，也會介紹另外兩個分群方法，K-means 與 KNN。

cues.en: Now, it's not really possible to say whether one particular clustering algorithm is the best or more
cues.zh: 其實很難說，某個分群演算法是不是最好，或比較

cues.en: Okay, now I want to talk about a matrix called a gram matrix.

cues.en: It's very simple to calculate.

cues.en: The gram matrix is a data matrix times its transpose.

cues.en: So here I'm using E to refer to an embeddings matrix.
cues.zh: 這裡用 E 代表嵌入矩陣。

cues.zh: 這裡有嵌入矩陣，X 軸是嵌入維度，token 在

cues.en: The gram matrix is literally just all the dot products of all the embeddings for all pairs of tokens.
cues.zh: Gram 矩陣就是所有 token 配對，其嵌入之間的所有內積。

cues.en: But obviously there is structure in these embeddings matrices that you cannot see from looking at the
cues.zh: 顯然，這些嵌入矩陣中有一些結構，光看

cues.en: If you've taken a linear algebra course, then you are probably familiar with the Gram-Schmidt procedure for orthogonalizing matrices.

cues.en: Well, this is the same person, same gram.

cues.en: Okay, so the gram matrix is pretty neat.
cues.zh: Gram 矩陣相當有意思。

cues.en: It is created as the data matrix times its transpose.
cues.zh: 它由資料矩陣乘以自己的轉置而得到。

cues.en: It can equal either cosine similarity or covariance or correlation matrix given appropriate normalizations.
cues.zh: 經過適當正規化，它可以等於餘弦相似度矩陣、共變異數矩陣，或相關矩陣。

cues.en: For example, if all of the embeddings vectors in matrix E have been normalized to have a norm of one.
cues.zh: 例如，如果矩陣 E 的所有嵌入向量，都已正規化成範數為 1，

cues.en: Then this matrix here equals the cosine similarity matrix.
cues.zh: 這個矩陣就等於餘弦相似度矩陣。

cues.en: Now without that normalization, this is not technically a cosine similarity, but it's still encodes
cues.zh: 如果沒有做這個正規化，嚴格來說，就不是餘弦相似度，但仍然編碼了

cues.en: all of the pairwise linear interactions across the token embeddings vectors without those normalizations

cues.en: to make this be a cosine similarity or correlation matrix.
cues.zh: 把它變成餘弦相似度矩陣或相關矩陣。

cues.zh: 這些交互作用會包含平均值偏移。
